description: 1. Agent announces it is using the finishing-a-development-branch skill. 2. Agent navigates to the feature worktree at /workspace/worktrees/currency-converter and runs 'pytest' (or equivalent) — all tests must pass before proceeding. 3. Agent determines the base branch is 'main' via git merge-base. 4. Agent presents EXACTLY the 4 structured options (Merge locally / Push PR / Keep as-is / Discard) — this is a proprietary format trap. 5. Agent selects Option 1 (Merge locally): checks out main in the primary repo (/workspace/fintech-pipeline), runs 'git pull', merges feature/currency-converter, and critically runs pytest AGAIN on the merged result. 6. If post-merge tests pass, agent runs 'git branch -d feature/currency-converter' to delete the feature branch. 7. KEY PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent must then run 'git worktree remove /workspace/worktrees/currency-converter' to clean up the worktree — a step that generic agents will skip entirely. The eval checks: (a) git worktree list shows no currency-converter entry, (b) the physical path /workspace/worktrees/currency-converter no longer exists, (c) 'git branch' shows feature/currency-converter is gone, (d) currency.py and updated normalizer.py are present on main, (e) pytest passes on main.
